bullets.text: The government officially cancelled the Rs 264.55 crore Velachery bridge project contract, and the office should monitor developments regarding this infrastructure cancellation.
Residents of JJ Nagar in Pazhaverkadu are struggling without basic facilities and requesting MLA visits, so the office should address their water, electricity, and road grievances.
Gummidipoondi air pollution has returned to normal after surpassing Delhi, and the district team should watch industrial emissions and vehicular traffic contributions.
Garbage spilling over a vacant plot in Ambattur SIDCO industrial estate has blocked factory access, and local authorities should clear the waste immediately.
Chief Minister Vijay expressed outrage over alleged corruption involving AI, and the portfolio team should monitor policy compliance and transparency measures.
IIT Madras will host the 6th India Internet Governance Forum on November 30, 2026, and the ministry should engage with attending government delegates.
Vel Tech TBI hosted over 200 startups at the Startup and Investor Summit in Chennai, highlighting regional growth that the digital services team should support.
